  the 2025­2026 Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) program and budget.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Linda Hollinsworth, Finance Director, presented the staff report.

  Mayor De Paula closed the Public Hearing.

  A motion was made by Councilmember Farfan, seconded by Councilmember Roa, to approve
  recommendation.

  The motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 4; Farfan, Roa, Del Rio, De Paula
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 1; Vargas
  RECUSE: 0;

  Motion carried: 4–0–1–0

D.  NEW BUSINESS

There were no New Business items.

E.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, announced the start of youth baseball; that
the swimming lessons program has served over 188 kids; in June, we served 1,307 lunches to the youth
in our community; both sessions of the summer camp program have been filled; the concert in the park
will be held on August 8, 2025; and the events in October will be the golf tournament and Halloween
events.

G.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Councilmember Roa reported that he attended the ICA Independent Cities Association Summer
Conference.

Councilmember Farfan, reported that he attended the ICA Independent Cities Association Summer
Conference; and was able to attend the teen overnight camp in Bishop with the rugby team and teen

Mayor Pro Tem Del Rio reported that she attended the annual Car Show.

Mayor De Paula reported that he attended the ICA Independent Cities Association Summer
Conference; and attended the annual Car Show.

1.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION
  Pursuant to Government Code Section 54957
  Title: City Manager

  Norma Tabares, City Attorney, read the Closed Session items into the record.

  The City Council recessed to Closed Session at 7:36 PM.

  The City Council reconvened from Closed Session at 8:12 PM.

  Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, conducted a roll call and announced a quorum.

  Norma Tabares, City Attorney, stated no reportable action from Closed Session.

I.  ADJOURNMENT

The City Council adjourned the meeting at 8:13 PM to the next Regular City Council meeting to be held
on Wednesday, August 13, 2025 at 6:00 PM.
